# simulator.injectSPortFrame

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Simulate S.Port telemetry.

```lua
simulator.injectSPortFrame(frame)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frame` | table {module, band, rx, physId, primId, appId, value} | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
simulator.injectSPortFrame({module=0, band=0, rx=0, physId=0x1B, primId=0x10, appId=0x6800, value=0x80})
```
